paper.title: SkillForge: Forging Domain-Specific, Self-Evolving Agent Skills in Cloud Technical Support
paper.central_claim: 领域知识驱动skill创建并经故障分析→诊断→定向优化，持续自演化、普遍改进不同起点技能并超越成熟人工系统。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet类型执行；环境标示gpt-6.1-sol，无独立运行凭据/会话ID可存，不额外探测。

sections_read: 固定v2全文§1–4及Appendix A–F、Tables1–5、prompt和案例；manifest无页图；无成本表/方差/模块消融

evidence.quote: generic skill creators lack domain grounding, producing poorly aligned initial skills
evidence.support_explanation: 具体领域知识和维护gap，广义无系统机制需近邻核查

evidence.quote:
Root Cause Attribution
: For each failure category, map issues to specific SKILL.md locations and classify defect types (missing, insufficient, incorrect)
evidence.support_explanation: 从批量故障归因到具体文件位置

evidence.quote: : Preserve existing correct behaviors through additive changes; never delete working content
evidence.support_explanation: 保守编辑是原则，不是实测非退化门控

evidence.quote: as a single-turn dialogue within a ticket that can advance ticket resolution—the input is the ticket’s message history (including the current user query), and the agent returns a customer-facing reply. A single ticket may involve multiple tasks. Within each scenario, tickets are sorted chronologically and partitioned into four equal-sized splits (25% each).
evidence.support_explanation: ticket级时间切分，避免同ticket多turn跨集合

evidence.quote: , never seen during evolution, and is used to assess the generalizability of the optimizations.
evidence.support_explanation: 独立于演化的后续ticket评估；初始creator矿取来源未完全说清

evidence.quote: Each offline evaluation is repeated 3 times; we report the mean.
evidence.support_explanation: 三次评估均值，不等于三个独立优化seed，无CI

evidence.quote: each sample was independently labeled by two domain experts, and the Judge achieved over 90% agreement with the human consensus.
evidence.support_explanation: 测量有人类对齐抽查，但样本量与混淆矩阵未给

evidence.quote: All three starting points benefit from the self-evolution loop, with Strict CR gains of +10.99, +9.23, and +11.60 after three iterations respectively.
evidence.support_explanation: 冻结技能在heldout提升，非improver更新

evidence.quote: Strict CR over this legacy system on the same held-out set, confirming that domain-contextualized creation combined with automated self-evolution can surpass mature, human-engineered production systems.
evidence.support_explanation: +13.76pp是整套流程相对legacy，不隔离诊断模块

evidence.quote: : Skills generated by a generic skill creator (Claude Code with Claude-Sonnet-4.5) augmented with domain-specific tool schemas mined from historical tickets, but without access to domain knowledge or historical ticket content due to enterprise data privacy constraints.
evidence.support_explanation: creator模型及私有信息权限不同，不能单独归因结构

evidence.quote: Verify changes meet safety criteria (additive, consistent, evidence-backed)
evidence.support_explanation: 静态安全检查；无候选验证集比较/rollback接受规则

evidence.quote: Knowledge gaps (Priority 1) are addressed first because they are the root cause of cascading failures
evidence.support_explanation: 批量优先级及root cause解释；未有反事实归因准确性实测
